desc: Split s into tokens, scanning left to right. A space character separates tokens and produces nothing. A maximal run of decimal digits is a Num whose value is that number (leading zeros allowed). An identifier starts with a lowercase letter a-z or "_" and continues with as many lowercase letters, digits and "_" as possible; it is an Ident. Symbols are Sym tokens: first try the two-character symbols "==", "<=", ">=" and "!=", then the one-character symbols + - * / = < > ( ) and ",". A digit run stops at the first non-digit, so "12ab" is Num 12 then Ident "ab". Any other character (including uppercase letters, tabs and a lone "!") gives the error "unexpected character: C at N", where C is the character and N its 0-based position in s.

decls.canon:
type Token =
  | Num(value: Int)
  | Ident(name: String)
  | Sym(text: String)
